title: A Harbor for the Kitchen
author: Silas Marchetti
blurb: Theo Eastwick, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
